verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack describes Smithery's pricing, a free tier, or usage limits for prototyping connections before paying. The hosted connection services, accounts and API keys were shut down on 2026-10-31, so there is no current paid or free plan to evaluate. The AGPL license on the CLI repository is an open-source license, not a documented free tier of the product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can prototype my agent's tool connections on a meaningful free tier before paying anything
